summary: Phase 10B Knowledge Base frontend + RBAC validated end-to-end via Playwright. Super Admin can access /knowledge-base with all 4 tabs; Articles CRUD (create -> edit bumps v2 -> versions dialog shows v1 history -> archive works and appears under ARCHIVED filter). FAQ CRUD (create -> edit -> delete) works. Package Knowledge lists 7 packages from CRM with blue single-source-of-truth notice and expandable departures. Test AI returns a real Gemini answer with Package Used and Knowledge Used badge lists; sample chip fills input. RBAC: Sales & Accounting do NOT see 'Knowledge Base' in sidebar; direct nav to /knowledge-base does NOT render the KB page.

issues: Spec says non-super_admin should redirect to /dashboard; current implementation instead lands on the shared 403 Forbidden page (URL stays at /knowledge-base). Access is still enforced (KB page not rendered, backend also enforces role), so functionally safe, but behavior differs from stated requirement. Consider using <Navigate to='/dashboard' replace/> inside the RouteGuard or KnowledgeBase root if strict redirect is desired.

action_items: Optional: change RBAC guard for /knowledge-base to redirect to /dashboard (as per spec) instead of showing 403 Forbidden page for Sales/Accounting.
critical_code_review_comments: KnowledgeBase.jsx (~390 lines) is fine but four sub-tabs in one file — if it grows, split ArticlesTab/FaqTab/PackagesTab/TestAiTab into separate files.
Article edit dialog does not preload effective dates format validation; empty strings are sent — backend seems to handle it, but consider clearing to null.
Archive uses window.confirm — matches app pattern but shadcn AlertDialog would be more consistent with rest of app.
